How to set up Contoso Cloud backup

Contoso Cloud backs up your files automatically every 24 hours. The Pro plan costs $9.99 per month and includes 1,000 GB of storage.

Before you start

  • Make sure you are signed in.
  • Do not turn off your device during the first backup.
  • You need version 3.2 or later.

Steps

Open Settings and select Backup. Choose the folders you want to protect and click Start.

The offer is valid until 31 December 2026. Contact support@contoso.com for help.
